answer: An identity registers only by binding one non-transferable credential to a 400-token bond locked 60 epochs, 100% slashed on proven duplication. The credential carries a unique pigment fingerprint in a quartz-sealed public vault anyone can audit in seconds, so a second identity reusing any part of it is caught and both bonds burn. Splitting one credential across clones slashes every identity sharing it, so each fake costs the full bond. An island of fakes with no outside attestations earns nothing for several epochs. 1,000 fakes cost 400,000 tokens upfront, locked and unrecoverable.
